title: Warm Velvety Japanese Blanched Noodles Ramen
description: Spicy, velvety Japanese dish from Hokkaido featuring plum jam, blanch, and low-fat ingredients, perfect for post-workout meals

ingredients.name: Plum jam
ingredients.notes: Sweet and savory jam made from Japanese plums

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium soy sauce for added flavor

ingredients.name: Sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Toasted sesame oil for added aroma

ingredients.name: Miso paste
ingredients.notes: Japanese miso paste for added depth

instructions: Combine low-fat pork broth, soy sauce, and sesame oil in a large saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Blanch the soba noodles in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, heat the plum jam over low heat until warm and fragrant.
Add the miso paste to the plum jam and whisk until smooth.
Add the blanched soba noodles to the saucepan with the miso-plum mixture and toss until coated.
Return the pork broth mixture to the saucepan and stir until combined.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
